name: Research tasks starter set (multi-hop, verifiable)
description: A small starter set of BrowseComp/GAIA-style research questions: each needs two or more lookups chained together and has ONE short, stable, checkable answer, graded by a deterministic code grader (no LLM judge needed). These are original questions in the style of those benchmarks - not items copied from BrowseComp or GAIA - and are far too few and too easy to rank models; use them to check that an agent with search/browse tools can chain lookups, and as a template for your own tasks. Run with tool execution enabled.

tasks.question: The 1998 FIFA World Cup final was played in a stadium in the host country's capital region. Which river flows through that country's capital city?
William Herschel discovered a planet in 1781. What is the atomic number of the chemical element that was named after that planet?
Who was President of the United States when the Panama Canal officially opened to traffic in 1914? Give the president's surname.
The Colombian author of the novel 'One Hundred Years of Solitude' won the Nobel Prize in Literature. In which year?
The Canadian city of Moncton is in a province whose capital is a different, smaller city. What is that capital?
Albert Einstein was awarded his doctorate in 1905 by a university in Switzerland. In what year was that university founded?
Take the number of the Apollo mission that first landed humans on the Moon. What is the chemical symbol of the element with that atomic number?
The lead singer of the band that recorded 'Bohemian Rhapsody' was born in a place that is now part of which present-day country?
In which city is the Nobel Peace Prize awarded each year at a ceremony, as opposed to the other Nobel prizes which are awarded in Stockholm?
Reply with ONLY a JSON object with the keys "country" and "capital" for the country whose national flag is a red disc on a white field.
What is the only even prime number? Reply with just the number and nothing else.
